titulo_en: Verbs followed by gerund or infinitive

titulo_es.@es: Verbos seguidos de -ing o de infinitivo con to
titulo_es.@en: Verbs followed by -ing or infinitive with

titulo.@es: Verbos seguidos de -ing o de to

texto.@es: Después de **avoid** y **finish**, usa **-ing**: **avoid driving**, **finish reading**. Después de **decide** y **hope**, usa **to + forma base**: **decide to travel**, **hope to arrive**.
texto.@en: After **avoid** and **finish**, use **-ing**: **avoid driving**, **finish reading**. After **decide** and **hope**, use **to + forma base**: **decide to travel**, **hope to arrive**.

texto.@es: No digas **avoid to drive** ni **decide driving** para expresar estos patrones.
texto.@en: Do not say **avoid to drive** or **decide driving** to express these patterns.

frases.en: On Saturday, Maya avoided driving into the city.
frases.es: El sábado, Maya evitó conducir hasta el centro.

frases.en: She decided to take the train and hoped to arrive before noon.
frases.es: Decidió tomar el tren y esperaba llegar antes del mediodía.
analisis: decided to take; hoped to arrive

analisis.@en: decided to take; I expected to arrive

frases.en: On the journey, she finished reading her book.
frases.es: Durante el trayecto, terminó de leer su libro.

opciones.texto: She enjoys reading and plans to travel.

explicacion.@es: Enjoy va seguido de -ing; plan, de to + forma base.
explicacion.@en: Enjoy is followed by -ing; plan, to + base form.

opciones.texto: She enjoys to read and plans travelling.

explicacion.@es: Las formas que siguen a los dos verbos son incorrectas.
explicacion.@en: The forms that follow both verbs are incorrect.

opciones.texto: She enjoys to read and plans to travel.

explicacion.@es: «Enjoy» va seguido de -ing, no de to + verbo.
explicacion.@en: «Enjoy» is followed by -ing, not to + verb.

explicacion.@es: Finish va seguido de -ing.
explicacion.@en: Finish is followed by -ing.

pregunta.@en: Translation into English: «We decided to travel early.»

explicacion.@es: Decide va seguido de to + forma base.
explicacion.@en: Decide is followed by to + base form.

intro.@es: La forma del segundo verbo depende del primero: aprende el patrón junto con cada verbo. Por ejemplo, **avoid doing** pero **decide to do**.
intro.@en: The form of the second verb depends on the first: he learns the pattern along with each verb. For example, **avoid doing** but **decide to do**.
